Sustainability can broadly be defined as
Option A: The short-term maintenance of systems according to environmental, economic and social considerations
Option B: The long-term maintenance of processes according to environmental, economic and cultural considerations.
Option C: The short-term maintenance of systems according to environmental, political and social considerations.
Option D: The long-term maintenance of systems according to environmental, economic and social considerations.
